newsitem.title: USA: First Mississippi shareholders OK merger.
newsitem.headline: First Mississippi shareholders OK merger.

text.p: First Mississippi Corp said Friday its shareholders had approved the merger of its fertilizer operations with Mississpi Chemical Corp.
In the merger, First Mississippi shareholders will receive 0.334 Mississipi Chemical share for each First Mississippi share they own.
The merger will become effective after First Mississippi spins off its chemicals and non-fertilizer business to shareholders. The company said the spinoff is expected to occur on December 23.
The spun-off company -- ChemFirst Inc -- will trade on the New York Stock Exchange under the symbol "CEM."
The company said it would sell its steel operations in 1997.
